Our process begins with a detailed consultation to capture your vision, followed by a thorough site survey to ensure everything fits perfectly in your space. The soothing sounds and visuals of flowing water add tranquility and elegance, with options ranging from wall-mounted to bubbling fountains, and from natural rock to grotto-inspired waterfalls. reviews.text: We chose Advance pools because of the long term reputation of the highest level of service and warranty. After several years, we discovered a need to have the grout repaired and with one call, the issue was handled without any hassle or delay. The staff was extremely attentive and prompt.  Truly one of the best customer service teams out there.  Will use them again should we ever need another pool!!
reviews.author: Jeffrey Mann

reviews.text: I had talked with Brian back in February 2025 and he mentioned his business partner would come out next week to help us buildout our splash pad. I met with his business partner for about 2 hours going over the whole process and the timeline. He said he would send and estimate and down payment in about 2 weeks time and then we would get started. I never heard back from him and this is about 3 months ago. My calls were not returned and they have not tried to reach out to me at this point. Great customer service upfront but did not follow through on the backend. I’ve been able to find another company that has gotten the project started now but now the kids will not be able to play on our splash pad this summer because of the delay. Brian was very personable and so was his colleague which is why I give them a 2 star rating.
reviews.author: Max Buchwald Jr

reviews.text: We recently had Advance Pools build a pool for us! Honestly, we reluctantly did so just for future resale value; but it ended up being the best building decision we made! We absolutely love our pool and use it all the time! The reason it was the best Dec we made was because Advance Pools was so amazing! Timely! Detail Oriented! Customer Service oriented! Professional! True artists and experts every step of the process! It was seamless and flawless and the end product was beautiful and practical! We couldn’t be happier or more pleased!! Thank you, Adcance Poole!
reviews.author: Angie Callahan

reviews.text: We built our first pool with Advance Pool.  We had heard many bad stories from friends about the process of building a pool but our experience was great!  From the design of the pool, through construction, and service following has been very pleasing.  As with any large project, there are likely going to be a few bumps in the road…in every circumstance I left it to Advance Pools to handle and they did.  I am an extremely satisfied client and am looking forward to building another pool with them in the future!
reviews.author: Mark Patton

reviews.text: The Advanced Pools team was exceptional to work with.  They took the time to work with our home construction/landscape teams to ensure that the pool was designed perfectly and still came to our house to check on it and make sure the system was working properly.  We couldn't be happier with their professionalism and expertise.  The pool is awesome and our family and friends use it non-stop.  Go with Advanced Pools!
reviews.author: Benton Hyatt

reviews.text: We just finished building a new home and the team installed a new pool as part of the overall project.  It was a fantastic experience from the design, thru construction thru any of the ongoing service needs that popped up.  They have been a great team to work with. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Gary Wojtaszek

reviews.text: I have enjoyed working with Advance Pools.  From the office to the field workers, so professional.  I would highly recommend using them for all your pool needs. Glad we did!!
reviews.author: Candy Turney

reviews.text: Let me start by saying, I never leave reviews but I honestly felt I'd be remiss if I didn't share my experience.  First off, I am very particular.  Ok, for real I am super nitpicky and expect perfection.  Especially when spending what it costs to build a pool and outdoor living area.  I got bids from numerous pool builders large and small.  I can honestly say, I am so thankful that I went with Brian Prince and Advance Pools.  My reasoning for going with Advance was the fact that they are a boutique builder with an expertise on high end type projects and not an assembly line.  I have had feedback from numerous friends that went with big name builders that were not impressed with the experience and ended up with a cookie cutter pool.  I can thankfully say that I don't relate. To start, Brian was very clear and transparent during the sales process.  He was not at all like a salesman but rather very informative and educational which allowed us to make informed decisions on what we wanted.  Subsequently, he was very hands on not only with the pool design, but he also quarterbacked the rest of the contractors from landscape design to outdoor living.  During the construction, he was literally here every day making sure everything was perfect.  It's very obvious Brian and Advance care about the customers and the finished product.  We all love our new backyard and still aren't used to how amazing it looks.  If you want the best result for the money your going to spend building a pool, go with Advance. Thank You Brian!!!
reviews.author: Ryan Wright
